lessons: Before resolving a message from a record that already exists, confirm the record is committed: check rev_parse of HEAD:<record_path(id)>. Treat a record that exists only in the working tree as uncommitted.
If the record file is on disk but not in HEAD, commit it first. Use driver.effects.run with key ticket-plane/decisions/<id> and stage only that path. Call box.resolve only after that commit succeeds.
When checking a tombstone link against registry ids, accept only records committed in HEAD. An uncommitted or untracked decision file must not count as a valid link target.

Add a test where a record file is written to the working tree but not committed: the pass must make the chupa(decisions) commit before the message is resolved, with no LLM request. Add a test that an uncommitted registry id used as a tombstone link becomes a decision record.
Keep the rest of the diff as it is. The review found only this crash-resume flaw, and all gates and tests passed. Stay inside the fence: chupa/triage.py and tests/test_triage.py.
